name: Chess Game
source:
history of humanity occurred. It was preceded by many events and led to many consequences, such as the rapid development of artificial intelligence. On the other hand, this crisis overshadowed things that are more important to humans. Many conspiracy theories and speculations by ordinary people developed about why all of this was happening. However, the only way to discover the truth is to look at the bigger picture. You can find the real answer by examining the past, present, and future simultaneously, which is made possible by this game.

The story follows a character who is obsessed with chess and sees not only chess on the chessboard but also in life. He wonders who is moving the pieces in real life.

[From [url=https://janusparadox.itch.io/chess-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人类历史上的一场事件发生了。它此前有许多事件铺垫，也带来了诸多后果，例如人工智能的飞速发展。另一方面，这场危机掩盖了对人类而言更重要的事。普通人围绕这一切为何发生，提出了许多阴谋论与猜测。然而，想发现真相，唯一的方法就是纵观全局。同时考察过去、现在与未来，才能找到真正的答案，而本作让这件事成为可能。

故事围绕一个痴迷国际象棋的人展开。他不只在棋盘上看见棋局，也在生活中看见棋局。他想知道，现实生活中的棋子，究竟由谁推动。

[摘自[url=https://janusparadox.itch.io/chess-game]itch.io[/url]]
